newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Probe may threaten NCC/Siab merger - paper.
newsitem.headline: Probe may threaten NCC/Siab merger - paper.

text.p: A merger between Swedish construction groups NCC and Siab could be threatened by the competition authority which is launching a large investigation, daily Dagens Industri said on Thursday.
"So far I don't know what a delayed merger would mean in terms of costs," NCC chief executive Jan Sjoqvist told the newspaper.
"Worst of all would be if the competition authority would not approve the entire merger, or part of it, but I don't think it will decide to do so," he was quoted as saying.

The merger was planned for May but with Sweden's competition authority looking into whether the deal will mean an illegal monopoly it cannot take place until July 24 at the earliest, Dagens Industri said.
During the investigation the companies are not allowed to go ahead with any merger plans.
NCC and Siab announced plans to merge earlier this year and the offering period ended on May 2. Seven Siab shares gave four newly issued shares in NCC.
